items.title: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) was limited on Thursday.
items.text: Doubs has a chance to return this week, in time to face the Chargers, but he is still in the questionable column. If he upgrades tomorrow, he should be good to go. Doubs would theoretically be the Patriots’ No. 1 wide receiver, but this situation is shaky. He can be stashed in 12-team leagues. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (foot/ankle) did not practice on Thursday.
items.text: Tuten aggravates his ankle and foot issues in Week 11 against the Giants. He has been playing through the ailments for multiple weeks, and still has a chance to face the Titans this week. He is an RB1 if active. Chris Rodriguez (hand) should be rostered just in case. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jakobi Meyers (ankle) was limited on Thursday.
items.text: Meyers has played through this injury for weeks now. We expect him to do the same against the Titans on Sunday. Parker Washington (shoulder) suffered an injury today. If Washington is inactive, Meyers would slide into the No. 1 wide receiver role. He should be added in 12-team leagues. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Parker Washington (shoulder) was added to the injury report as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.text: This suggests Washington injured his shoulder at today’s practice. Hopefully, it is only a mild issue and he suits up as planned in Week 12 against the Titans. He is a WR1 if active. Jakobi Meyers (ankle) would benefit if Washington sits out this week. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jordan Addison (thumb) did not practice on Thursday.
items.text: Addison seems unlikely to face the 49ers this week, though Myles Price (knee/ankle) has a chance to play, having logged two limited practices. Addison is still worth stashing as a potential FLEX option in 12-team leagues. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Jahan Dotson (hamstring) did not practice on Thursday.
items.text: Dotson does not need to be rostered in 12-team leagues, nor does rookie Zachariah Branch (hamstring). The Falcons’ pass-catching corps is fairly condensed at this point. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Keaton Mitchell (knee) did not practice on Thursday.
items.text: Mitchell and David Njoku (shoulder) remain sidelined through two practices. The tight end group is highly unlikely to produce reliably this week, even with Njoku sidelined. Mitchell’s likely absence gives Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal touch-count boosts. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Justin Herbert (concussion) did not practice on Thursday.
items.text: Herbert is firmly on the wrong side of questionable at this time, likely leaving DJ Uiagalelei as the team’s starter against the Patriots this week. The Chargers also signed Jake Browning from the practice squad to the active roster, which bodes poorly for Herbert’s availability. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) is active for Week 12 against the Cowboys.
items.text: The Eagles’ No. 1 cornerback is good to go this week. The Eagles declared EDGE Arnold Ebiketie, QB Cole Payton, CB Jonathan Jones, EDGE A.J. Epenesa, OT Ajani Cornelius and TE Grant Calcaterra inactive for Week 12 against the Cowboys. Payton is the emergency third quarterback. - Nic Bodiford

items.title: Cowboys declared TE Jake Ferguson, RG Tyler Booker, WR Jonathan Mingo, S P.J. Locke, DT Jonathan Bullard and LB Jaishawn Barham inactive for Week 12 against the Eagles.
items.text: Ferguson will miss another game with knee and ankle injuries. Brevyn Spann-Ford is a touchdown-dependent fantasy TE2 in his stead. Ryan Flournoy will likely beneift from Ferguson’s absence. Losing Booker, the Cowboys’ starting right guard, for this one is unfortunate. - Nic Bodiford
